internal_structure: Retain necessary skeleton, joint bearings and sensor brackets; these are not the external support.
world_placement: All global translation and all three rotations (yaw, pitch, roll) are set manually in Unreal Placement. No world orientation or translation is inferred from joint encoders.
pelvis_reference: Pelvis forward defines local +X. pelvis.yaw/pitch/roll are declared fixed 0 rad with null raw samples; the other 41 axes are measured. Fixed reference is not a missing or zero-valued sensor.
current_validation: Rev M complete rigid bodies, finite-pose checks in verification/revM_complete_audit.json. No self-standing claim, continuous collision proof or physical qualification. Laying the whole doll down is a world transform and remains manual in UE.
